description: This file defines the `ExceptionContext` class, which manages detailed contextual information for exceptions within the Apache Commons Math library. It handles message patterns, arguments, and arbitrary key-value context data, providing serialization support and localization features.

classes.name: ExceptionContext
classes.description: Handles and stores exception-related contextual information, including message patterns, arguments, and additional key-value data, with support for localization and serialization.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the throwable (exception) associated with this context.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.description: Adds a localized message pattern and its arguments to the context.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Associates a key with a value in the context data.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specific key.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns all keys stored in the context.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Builds and returns the default message string.

methods.name: getLocalizedMessage
methods.description: Builds and returns the message string localized to the default locale.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Generates the message string based on a specific locale.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Generates the message string with a specific separator for multiple messages.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Constructs a concatenated message string from stored message patterns and arguments for a specified locale.

methods.name: writeObject
methods.description: Serializes the object, including message patterns, arguments, and context data.

methods.name: readObject
methods.description: Deserializes the object from a stream, restoring message and context data.

methods.name: nonSerializableReplacement
methods.description: Provides a string placeholder for objects that are not serializable.
